tokens.name: harbor-950
tokens.usage: Brand navy, deepest. Website footer band and the darkest end of the app icon plate.

tokens.name: harbor-900
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Ground for dark brand surfaces (cover, website hero).

tokens.name: harbor-800
tokens.usage: Brand navy. The mark's stem and arrow and the wordmark on light grounds (15:1 on white).

tokens.name: harbor-700
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Flat app icon plate at 16 to 32 px.

tokens.name: harbor-600
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Top of the app icon plate gradient; large brand blocks.

tokens.name: harbor-500
tokens.usage: Brand navy, lightest full tone. Secondary brand blocks and illustrations.

tokens.name: harbor-300
tokens.usage: Brand tint. Illustration detail on harbor grounds; never text on white.

tokens.name: harbor-100
tokens.usage: Brand tint. Light brand blocks and website section grounds.

tokens.name: signal-600
tokens.usage: Signal orange for light grounds: the mark's handle on white (3.6:1, a graphic, not text).

tokens.name: signal-500
tokens.usage: Signal orange for dark and navy grounds: the handle on harbor plates (5.8:1 on harbor-800).

tokens.name: signal-400
tokens.usage: Signal orange, light. Top of the handle gradient in the app icon.

tokens.name: signal-100
tokens.usage: Signal tint. Rare highlight blocks on the website; never a UI state.

tokens.name: brand-ground
tokens.usage: Large brand fields that must stand out from bg in both themes: the cover and website bands.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App window ground behind the sidebar and list.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Main list, detail panel and settings pages.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the command bar and dialogs; pair with a shadow token.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground, input wells and code blocks.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected and keyboard-focused rows in lists and the sidebar.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Row and ghost-button hover fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and panels. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, check boxes and secondary buttons (3.1:1 light, 3.8:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-raised and selection (above 13:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sizes, speeds, timestamps, help text, placeholders (5.3:1 or more on every ground).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and decorative icons only (3:1 or more); never readable body text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Progress fills, the active-download icon and the focus ring (3.2:1 or more on every ground). Never text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Ink on accent fills, such as a count badge.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: neutral, so orange stays the brand's one signal.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on primary buttons (17:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: state-done
tokens.usage: Complete state, with the check icon and the word 'Done' (6:1 or more). Blue, off the red-green axis.

tokens.name: state-error
tokens.usage: Failed state, with the alert icon and the reason in words (5:1 or more). Close in lightness to accent, so never shown without its icon.

tokens.name: state-paused
tokens.usage: Paused and queued states, with the pause or clock icon.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid ring, offset 2px, on every focusable control.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page titles in settings and dialogs.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Detail panel title and section headers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: rows, menus, settings.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: File names in rows; button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines, sidebar counts, help text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Sizes, speeds, times left, percentages and addresses. Tabular figures always.

styles.name: mono-strong
styles.usage: The one number a row leads with (total size or speed).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows; button horizontal padding at small size.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; gaps between controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between row groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; settings section gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state and page padding.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Download list row height (two lines at body and small).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar width; collapsible.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rows on hover.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the command bar, and 24px-tall capsules.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: progress bars and toggles, the handle's shape in the UI.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the command bar.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets only.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the detail panel opening.

tokens.name: duration-tug
tokens.usage: The tug: a new download's arrow dips 2px and settles, once.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or opens.

tokens.name: ease-tug
tokens.usage: The tug only: a small overshoot, like a line pulled taut.
